newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hitachi to build 150 bln yen chip plant - paper.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi to build 150 bln yen chip plant - paper.

text.p: Hitachi Ltd will invest 150 billion yen to build a new plant in Japan to begin mass production of next-generation semiconductors, including 256 megabit dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) chips, in the second half of 1999, a business daily said on Tuesday.
Hitachi is expected to increase its capital investment plan for the year to March 31, 1998, due to the investment in the new plant, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
Hitachi spokesmen were not immediately available for comment on the report.
